query: ast semantic aware embedding retrieval ranking

ranking.diagnosticFormula: diagnosticScore = blendedScore * (0.70 + 0.30*documentIntegrityScore) -- DIAGNOSTIC RANK ONLY, not a promotion signal
ranking.promotionGate: acePromotionEligible = (documentIntegrity.status === INTEGRITY_VERIFIED) -- hard boolean, independent of diagnosticScore

turbovec.note: Use --with-turbovec to build the accelerator index from fetched Qdrant vectors.
